headline: US SEC Monitoring Corporate Disclosures Regarding Artificial Intelligence
summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's top enforcement official stated that the agency is actively monitoring corporate disclosures concerning artificial intelligence.
why: Regulatory scrutiny over AI disclosures aims to prevent misleading statements or inflated claims by public companies regarding their technological capabilities.

impacts.name: Technology Sector
impacts.why: Increased SEC monitoring on AI claims affects compliance requirements for tech firms.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
